name: If I Had A Nickel For Every Time
aka: Doof If I Had A Nickel
look: A still from Phineas and Ferb above a black caption area. Dr. Doofenshmirtz, in a white lab coat, clasps his hands and glances sideways at a white sock puppet on the right, in front of a wall of identical dark robots. White text below holds the nickel line.
text: If I had a nickel for every time
Which isn't a lot but it's weird that it happened twice.
use: You fill in the gap after 'for every time' with an oddly specific thing that has happened exactly twice, often two shows or movies sharing a strange plot point, or two weird coincidences in your own life.
slots: the oddly specific thing that happened twice, after 'for every time'
examples: my cat knocked my phone into the bathtub
the fire alarm went off during a math test
describe: phineas and ferb scientist with a caption about nickels
cartoon doctor in a lab coat next to a sock puppet
i'd have two nickels which isn't a lot but it's weird it happened twice
doofenshmirtz looking awkward with robots behind him
evil scientist clasping his hands with text about something happening twice
origin: A line spoken by Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz in Phineas and Ferb.
